messages.subject: Project Quartz - IP due diligence report
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor and Raj,

Attached is our IP due diligence report on the QX-Clock family. Headline: the family is owned by Arkwright and can be licensed exclusively in the defence field, subject to carving out the Meridian research licence on QX-2 and disclosing the QX-4 Japan examination position. No fixed charge over the registered IP under the Clydesford debenture. Section 4 has our recommendations.

Kind regards,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

Whitfield Carter LLP. Confidential and may be legally privileged.
